# Cisco

> Cisco provides enterprise AI infrastructure, secure networking solutions, and intelligent software platforms for global organizations.

Cisco is a Fortune 500 technology company specializing in AI-powered networking, zero-trust security, and edge computing solutions. The company offers comprehensive infrastructure and software products designed for enterprise digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- AI Infrastructure
- Secure Networking
- Zero-Trust Security
- AI Canvas
- Cisco Secure AI Factory
- Silicon One
- Hybrid Mesh Firewall
- Edge Computing
- AgenticOps
- Smart Switches
- Unified Edge
- AI Innovation
- Enterprise Security
- Agentic Operations
